verdict.rationale: pnpm documents installing packages from a local content-addressable store: files are hard-linked from a single store, and an offline mode uses only packages already in the store. That covers the 'install from a cache' half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows it caches prebuilt binaries or build outputs to avoid compiling native packages from source. Missing for 10: evidence of caching or reusing prebuilt binaries or build results (skipping compilation), documentation of how native or binary packages are handled, independent corroboration.
